rules.statement: A party who acquires a new and independent title to the subject matter of a previous litigation subsequent to a decree in that earlier action is not barred by res judicata from setting up that new title.
rules.supporting_quote: "As the appellants are setting up a new and independent title which they acquired after the decree in the earlier case, to the Lot in dispute, we hold that their cause for claiming is different from the claim they set up in the earlier action and it is not barred by the plea of res judicata."
